menuImport.intro: Photograph every page of the paper menu. We read the dishes and prices and translate the names into the other two languages; you check everything before it's published.
menuImport.privacy: Google Gemini reads the photos. On the free tier, Google may use them to improve its services.
menuImport.choosePhotosHint: Up to 8 photos, one per page.

menuImport.reading: Reading the menu. This usually takes half a minute.
menuImport.readingElsewhere: The menu is still being read. This page refreshes by itself.

errors.rate_limited: Today's limit for reading menus is used up. Try tomorrow, or fill in the menu by hand.
errors.unreadable: The photo couldn't be read. Take it closer and in good light, then try again.
errors.not_a_menu: We couldn't find a menu in the photos. Check that you chose the right ones.
errors.provider_unavailable: The reading service isn't available right now. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.price_required: Some dishes have no price. Type the prices in and try again.
errors.name_required: Every dish and section needs an Armenian name.

menuImport.reviewNotice: The translations were made automatically. Check the names and prices before publishing.
